// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / intervals / numeric
type Digit = 0..=9;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

type UserPort = 1024..=65535;

// types / intervals / character
type LowerAscii = 'a'..='z';
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

// types / intervals / static constraints
struct InlineBuffer<T, comptime N: 0..=4096> {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    storage: [T; N];
}
